title: Funnel Conversion Leaks: Where Visitors Become Lost Revenue
description: Find funnel conversion leaks at each stage — awareness, interest, decision, action — with benchmarks and fix patterns.

faq.a: Friction, slow response, unclear value prop, trust gaps, and missing recovery flows at each transition.

faq.q: Which funnel stage leaks the most?
faq.a: Depends on business: B2B often leaks at demo-to-close; ecommerce at cart-to-purchase; SaaS at trial-to-paid.

blocks.text: Funnel conversion leaks are drop-offs between stages that should connect. You do not need perfect analytics — compare each transition to a benchmark and estimate dollars left on the table.

items: Awareness → interest: wrong audience or weak hook
Interest → intent: no clear next step or social proof
Intent → purchase: checkout friction, pricing shock
Purchase → repeat: no onboarding to second order

blocks.headline: Map your funnel and score each stage
